About this Peg

Wood-fired pizza in Glastonbury

Our first Square Peg. Glastonbury is where the wood-fired oven got lit in 2020, and it’s still where regulars come for date nights, team dinners, and the same pie they’ve ordered since day one.

Every pie starts with dough made fresh daily and never frozen. Choose a red or white signature pie, build your own, or go gluten-free with our 12″ crust. Vegan cheese is available on any pizza.

Good to know

Glastonbury FAQ

What are Square Peg None’s hours?

Mon–Tue 11:30am–9pm; Wed–Thu 11:30am–10pm; Fri 11:30am–12am; Sat 11am–11pm; Sun 11am–9pm. Holiday hours may vary; online ordering always shows live availability.

Can I order online from Square Peg None?

Yes. Tap “Order None online” to order for pickup, or choose delivery at checkout where it’s available.

Do you have gluten-free or vegan options?

Yes. We offer a 12″ gluten-free crust, and vegan cheese can be added to any pizza.

Does Square Peg None do catering?

Yes. None caters birthdays, office lunches, team events and more. Send a quick request on our catering page, or call (860) 286-0415.

Is Square Peg None close to Wethersfield and Rocky Hill?

Yes. Square Peg None at 1001 Hebron Ave in Glastonbury is a short drive from Wethersfield, Rocky Hill, Portland, Hebron and Marlborough. Order ahead online for pickup, or check delivery availability at checkout.

Can our group host a fundraiser here?

Yes. Every Tuesday from 4pm to close, one organization earns 20% of dine-in food sales from its supporters.
